ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it is known that the coordinates of the intersection point of the function $y=ax+b$ with the $y$-axis are $(0,2)$,\\
hence, the solution set of the inequality $ax+b<2$ is $x>0$,\\
therefore, the answer is $\boxed{x>0}$.
